leadText: Akira Ishida (Japanese: 石田彰 Ishida Akira) is a Japanese voice actor for . Ishida's most famous role in the series is that of Falkner.
plainText:
Akira Ishida (Japanese: 石田彰 Ishida Akira) is a Japanese voice actor for . Ishida's most famous role in the series is that of Falkner.

==Biography==
Ishida was born on November 2, 1967, in , . He came to in 1986 to study Theatre at Nihon University's School of Arts and joined Mausu Promotion in 1988 prior to his graduation. Upon graduation in 1990, he continued his affiliation with Mausu Promotion, but after 21 years with the company, he left in 2009 and spent a period of time freelancing. He eventually joined Gerbera Peerless Ltd.

In 2007, he notably earned the "Best Supporting Character (male)" award at the first "Seiyu Awards" for his portrayal of Athrun Zala in Gundam Seed Destiny. He was also selected as the most popular male actor in the 2004 Animage Anime Grand Prix for the same role.
